title: Reject late local-model load success for cancelled callers
goal: Ensure LocalModelRuntimeCoordinator does not return a successfully loaded engine to a caller whose load request was cancelled while awaiting the shared load task.
context: loadActiveModel intentionally shares one unstructured task to avoid duplicate GGUF loads, but both the shared-task and owner paths return task.value without checking the caller's cancellation. A late successful load can therefore be reported as success to a cancelled request.
forbidden_changes: Do not cancel shared model loading merely because one waiter cancels.
Do not allow duplicate concurrent model loads.
Do not alter GGUF validation or active model selection semantics.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
acceptance_criteria: Both shared and owner wait paths check caller cancellation after awaiting the shared load task.
Regression test uses a deterministic delayed fake engine and proves late successful load is rejected after caller cancellation.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert the cancellation guard if it cancels shared load tasks or breaks existing model lifecycle behavior.
